name: Cornstarch Souffles
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan
Add to it the cornstarch and sugar and mix them together
Add milk heated to nearly boiling
Stir well with a wooden spoon until it boils and thickens
Let it cool and beat well into it the yolks of the eggs
Beat the whites to a stiff froth and stir gently into the mixture
Slightly butter a dish, pour in the mixture and bake in a slow oven
Serve quickly as Souffles will soon fall

source.originalInstructions:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan
2. Add to it the cornstarch and sugar and mix them together
3. Add milk heated to nearly boiling
4. Stir well with a wooden spoon until it boils and thickens
5. Let it cool and beat well into it the yolks of the eggs
6. Beat the whites to a stiff froth and stir gently into the mixture
7. Add any flavoring you like
8. Slightly butter a dish, pour in the mixture and bake in a slow oven
9. Serve quickly as Souffles will soon fall
